research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Wheel is focused on enhancing virtual care through innovative middleware computing platforms. Their R&D efforts include maintaining an active user pool and developing interfaces for user-to-user service platforms. These advancements aim to streamline scheduling and service requests, facilitating efficient interactions between users of different computing platforms. This approach underscores Wheel's commitment to improving the accessibility and quality of virtual healthcare services.

product_launches.description: Wheel launched two major additions to its Horizon virtual care platform: an AI-native Clinical Action Layer that converts AI-generated health context into compliant clinical workflows, and WheelX, an enterprise exchange to distribute AI health experiences to enterprise buyers.

overview_description.description:
Wheel is a healthcare technology company that brings together the tech infrastructure and clinicians to power virtual care and telehealth. It provides companies and clinicians with everything they need to deliver care virtually. Today, Wheel powers virtual-first care for the most forward-thinking organizations in healthcare — including digital health companies, clinical lab networks, retailers, and tech companies.

Wheel was founded in January 2018 by Michelle Davey and Griffin Mulcahey.

about_short_description.short_description: wheel is a healthcare technology company that provides virtual care for patients.

product.name: Wheel Horizon™
product.description: A modular telehealth infrastructure platform that enables organizations to launch, operate, and scale branded virtual care programs with clinical, operational, patient experience, and compliance functionality.

product.name: Nationwide Clinician Network
product.description: A technology-enabled network of physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, physician assistants, behavioral health specialists, and dietitians providing asynchronous and video-based virtual care across the United States.

product.name: Integrated Clinical Operations
product.description: Clinical and operational support for launching and managing virtual care, including provider credentialing, protocol implementation, care delivery workflows, and ongoing program operations.

product.name: Connected Services
product.description: Integrated connections for prescriptions, pharmacy fulfillment, laboratory orders, insurance, patient payments, and remote patient monitoring within virtual care workflows.

product.name: Virtual Care Analytics and Optimization
product.description: Real-time reporting and analytics for monitoring patient engagement, visit activity, clinician performance, clinical outcomes, program trends, and virtual care return on investment.

product.name: Evidence-Based Care Programs
product.description: Protocol-driven virtual care programs for high-demand needs, including weight management, menopause, sexual health, convenience care, urgent care, condition management, and custom programs.
